newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Residential raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Residential raised.

text.p: Jeffries & Co Inc said on Thursday it raised its rating on the shares of American Residential Services Inc to buy from accumulate, with a target of $28 to $29 per share.

-- Analyst James Wilson said he expected the company to continue to take advantage of acquisition opportunities and anticipated it would drive at least 30 percent annual earnings growth over the next three years.
-- He also said in a research note the company was focused on achieving operational efficiencies which could lead to some very significant margin expansion.
